title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Academic Program Mode of Delivery
For any academic
program
(degree, certificate, diploma or other credit-bearing credential), students will be able to complete all program requirements in the official
program modality if they follow the typical length and scheduling patterns of the program. The
University does not guarantee that students will be able to complete all program requirements in the
official program modality if the student follows an alternate path.
In-Person Program
Students can complete their program primarily through
in-person courses
. Required courses in the degree
are offered in in-person, hyflex, or in-person hybrid mode. Programs may include a maximum of 1.0 credit of required courses offered virtual synchronous, virtual asynchronous or virtual hybrid mode, of which no more than 0.5 credit may be within the program's required courses for Year 1 of study.  Sufficient in-person
electives
are available for
the student to complete their degree. Programs may choose if they will require all required courses to be
taken in-person, or if they will allow students to complete required courses in alternate modes of
delivery.
Virtual Asynchronous Program
Students can complete their program fully through
virtual asynchronous courses
. All required courses in
the degree are offered as virtual asynchronous. Sufficient virtual asynchronous electives are available for
the student to complete their degree.
Virtual Synchronous Program
Students can complete the required components of their program through
virtual synchronous courses
.
Some virtual asynchronous electives may be required to complete the degree. Sufficient virtual
synchronous and virtual asynchronous electives are available for the student to complete their degree.
Hybrid Program
There are two categories of hybrid program: In-Person Hybrid and Virtual Hybrid.
In-Person Hybrid Program
Students can complete their degree through a combination of in-person and virtual course modes. A minimum of 50%
of required courses are offered in-person, hyflex, or in-person hybrid mode. The combination of modes
of delivery is clearly communicated to potential students.
Virtual Hybrid Program
Students can complete their degree through a combination of virtual course modes. A minimum of 50%
of required courses are offered virtual synchronous or virtual hybrid mode. The combination of
modes of delivery is clearly communicated to potential students.
